implants.title: Dental Implants
paras: Dental implants may be one option for replacing a missing tooth or supporting a larger tooth-replacement plan. The right path depends on an evaluation, medical history, bone and gum findings, and the alternatives that fit your goals.

The practice materials reference implant-planning experience and affiliations, but the exact credentials, pricing, and offer terms remain pending named approval. Ask the team what is confirmed for your visit.
items: Full-arch replacement options discussed when appropriate
Planning, surgical, and referral boundaries reviewed

restorative.title: Full Mouth Restoration
paras: Comprehensive restorative care can address health, function, and appearance through a plan tailored to your findings and goals. The materials, sequence, and number of visits depend on the proposed treatment.
items: Restoration materials selected for the proposed plan

crowns.title: Same-Day Dental Crowns
paras: For selected crown visits, the CEREC workflow may support digital design and in-office milling. The team will confirm whether the tooth and treatment plan are appropriate and whether another visit is needed.

dentures.title: Dentures
paras: Removable dentures and implant-supported options can be discussed as part of a tooth-replacement plan. Fit, comfort, appearance, and follow-up needs depend on the individual evaluation.

root-canals.title: Root Canals
paras: Root canal therapy may help address a tooth with inflamed or infected inner tissue and may preserve the natural tooth when it is clinically appropriate. The team can explain the evaluation, alternatives, and comfort plan.

cosmetic.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
paras: If you want to change the appearance of your smile, a consultation can compare confirmed options such as veneers or crowns with their tradeoffs, maintenance, and alternatives.

veneers.title: Porcelain Veneers
paras: Porcelain veneers are appearance-focused restorations that may change tooth shape, shade, or proportion. Candidacy, preparation, maintenance, and expected longevity should be discussed for the proposed plan.

preventive.title: Preventive Care & Cleanings
paras: Preventive visits can include cleaning, examination, and oral-health education based on the team’s findings. The team can explain what maintenance schedule fits your needs.

invisalign.title: Invisalign®
paras: Invisalign clear aligners may be an option for some teens and adults. The team can review whether aligners fit your goals, routine, and treatment needs.

oral-surgery.title: Oral Surgery
paras: From extractions to implant-related procedures, the appropriate scope, provider, imaging, comfort plan, and referral boundary should be confirmed during consultation.

sedation.title: Sedation Dentistry
paras: If dental anxiety is part of your concern, tell the team. Sedation options, candidacy, medication instructions, monitoring, recovery, and alternatives require an individualized clinical discussion.

tmj.title: TMJ Treatment
paras: Jaw pain, clicking, or tension can be reasons to request an evaluation. The cause, treatment options, and need for referral cannot be determined by this page alone.

srp.title: Scaling & Root Planing
paras: Also called a deep cleaning, scaling and root planing addresses plaque and tartar below the gumline when the clinician recommends it. The team can explain the findings, sequence, comfort plan, and alternatives.
Follow-up and home-care needs vary. The practice can review the proposed maintenance plan and what symptoms or changes should prompt a call.
